Name: Obstacle Remover
Author: StultusVMods
Description:
My friend and I got a little annoyed of those rocks and logs that you can't walk over around the game, so I made a small content pack that makes it so you can walk through them. It should work for the bus stop, cindersap forest, town, beach, and mountain. Please let me know if you spot a rock that I missed so I can get it fixed ASAP, I hate those things
